curatedMovie.curiosityHook: As childhood blunders turn into adult responsibilities, what will it take for Piero to finally find his footing?
curatedMovie.description: Growing up in a working-class neighborhood of Livorno, young Piero faces life's persistent lessons the hard way, navigating hardship and personal growth on an enduring journey toward fatherhood.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Thoughtful, funny, and bittersweet, moving at a steady pace that balances emotional weight with approachable warmth.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directed by Paolo Virzì, this Italian comedy-drama blends candid humor with heartfelt working-class grit, offering a grounded and reflective coming-of-age chronicle.
